summary: Phase 7 (Avatar upload, Gathering albums, Self check-in, Prayer digests, Birthday automation) full backend + UI smoke. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase7.py 35/35 PASS. Covered: avatar POST/DELETE propagates to users.picture + member_prayers.author_picture, picture_custom flag set/unset, non-image rejected (415), admin POST/DELETE /api/admin/members/{uid}/photo gated to admin, 404 missing user, avatar id excluded from GET /api/media. Albums: GET /api/members/albums only includes meetings with date <= ET today, future-date upload returns 400, member upload status=pending, admin upload auto-approved, album detail visibility (owner sees own pending + approved, other member sees approved only, admin sees all), GET /api/members/gathering-photos/{pid}/file returns 404 to non-owner for pending/approved not-owned, GET /api/media/file/<id> returns 404 for gathering category (private), /api/media list hides gathering, admin queue + approve flow, member withdraw-own-pending (403 for others / 403 for own approved), admin can delete any. Self check-in: door token stable + reset generates new, bad token 404, info endpoint reports open=True today / open=False for future, POST /api/members/self-checkin marks attendance=present + checkins.by='self' + guests (0-20 bounds enforced), future-date POST 400, sheet counts.guests >= self guests. Prayer digests (direct function calls with send_email monkeypatched): _send_prayer_author_digests sends exactly 1 email summarising B's pray+encourage (self-praying filtered), second call sends 0 (digest_at updated), _send_prayer_weekly respects member_profile.prayer_weekly=False (opted-out B gets no email), anonymous posts rendered as 'a sister' (real name 'Ama QA Sister' not leaked), PUT /api/members/profile persists prayer_weekly. Birthdays: GET /api/members/birthdays/today returns celebrants, _send_birthday_emails is idempotent per year (member_bday_sent_year marker), creates birthday Discussion thread (key=birthday:<uid>:<year>), _send_staff_birthday_list returns False when settings.staff_notify_email is empty. Frontend (Playwright): seeded today's QA UI Phase7 meeting with door token. Self check-in page (/self-checkin?m=&t=): mem_tok_a sees self-checkin-page + self-checkin-title ('QA UI Phase7 Gathering'), self-guest-plus bumps self-guest-count, self-checkin-btn transitions to self-checkin-done. Portal (member cookie): clicking portal-tab-photos renders albums-grid with 1 album-tile-<id>, tile opens album-view with album-upload-input. portal-tab-me shows profile-photo-input (Add a photo) + profile-prayer-weekly checkbox (default checked). Birthday banner: with birthday seeded for user A, user B's /members home shows birthday-today-banner reading 'Happy Birthday, Ama!'. Admin (qa_tok_123) /admin -> Members section: tabs members-sub-people (shows admin-photo-input-<uid> + admin-photo-remove-<uid>) and members-sub-photos (shows admin-gathering-photos review queue) both render. /checkin: ci-door-btn opens door-qr-modal with door-qr SVG + door-qr-close + door-qr-reset. Phase 6 regression (test_members_phase6.py) re-ran but hit shared-IP rate-limit on prayer endpoints when run back-to-back with Phase 7; this is a pre-existing per-IP-bucket design (already called out in iteration_27 code review) and not a Phase 7 regression.

minor.issue: Shared /app rate_limit bucket is per-IP, so running Phase 6 + Phase 7 pytest back-to-back from one test host trips 429 on prayer creates during fixture setup. Previously flagged in iteration_27 review. Suggest per-user bucket for prayer/thread write endpoints.

issues: React console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning for ci-meeting-select because an inline <span> wrapper is injected into the <option> element at CheckIn.jsx:108. Browsers tolerate it but React logs an error on every render.

action_items: Consider per-user rate-limit bucket for member write endpoints (prayers, encouragements, threads) so active sisters are not throttled across unrelated features.
Fix hydration warning for ci-meeting-select (CheckIn.jsx:108) — render the title as a plain string child instead of a wrapped .
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~8980 lines. Phase 7 added ~390 lines inline near the bottom. The phase-7 block should be split into backend/members/{photos, albums, selfcheckin, digests, birthdays}.py routers (same recommendation as iteration_27). Each router <120 lines and the member-portal file would drop below the 700-line review threshold per module.

_send_prayer_weekly reads `member_profile.prayer_weekly: {$ne: False}` which also sends to members who have no profile at all — this is intentional (opt-in by default) but should be documented alongside the My Profile checkbox copy so staff knows new members auto-receive the Monday digest.

_send_birthday_emails sends N emails per celebrant (one card + one per other active member). For a 200-member club with multiple same-day birthdays this is O(N^2) SMTP calls synchronously inside the scheduled task — moving to a background queue / batching would avoid long startup stalls.

_send_prayer_author_digests marks digest_at for ALL prayers found, including the ones that produced the email, in a single update_many. If send_email raises after the update, the next run will not resend. Consider updating digest_at only after successful send per-author.

members_album_upload _rate_limit per IP (max 30 / 10min) is shared across all meetings — a sister uploading a 25-photo album for one gathering could then be rate-limited from uploading to another gathering in the same window. Bucket by (user, meeting) or raise to 60.

admin_door_code returns the SAME token on every GET (good for stable QR) but the token lives forever once set. If a meeting is re-used (unlikely) or if the token leaks (e.g., staff screenshot), there is no auto-rotation. OK since staff can POST .../door/reset manually.
members_self_checkin accepts guests up to 20 but does not validate against meeting capacity (if member RSVP guest count was 0 and sister shows up with 20 on the day, no sheet alert). Minor.

GET /api/members/albums builds the cover URL from the FIRST approved photo (sort by created_at asc). Deleting the current cover does not refresh older gatherings' covers until the next request — this is fine, but worth noting that there is no 'featured' flag to let staff pick a cover.
members_photo_upload and admin_member_photo both call _store_upload with uploader string that is user_id for members but email for admins. Minor inconsistency — pick one audit identity.

success_rate.backend: 100% (35/35) phase 7; phase 6 regression hit shared-IP rate-limit (pre-existing)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed phase-7 testids present and functional

test_credentials: Admin: session_token=qa_tok_123 (qa_session.py). Members: mem_tok_a + mem_tok_b (qa_members.py), both activated via admin invite + member_status='active'. Teardown executed: qa_members.py down && qa_session.py down. QA UI meeting + any uploaded gathering photos + any birthday thread + QA prayers cleaned.
seed_data_creation: Transient inside tests via Mongo direct inserts (qa-ph7-meet-<today>, qa-ph7-self-today, qa-ph7-self-tomorrow, qa-ui-ph7-meet) and HTTP POST (prayers, gathering photos). All deleted via class-scoped fixtures + explicit cleanup script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase7.py (35 tests). Prereq: python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up && python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_members.py up && manually set users.member_status='active' + member_since for qa_mem_a/b in Mongo. Then: python3 -m pytest backend/tests/test_members_phase7.py -o 'addopts=' -p no:warnings --junitxml=test_reports/pytest/iterNN.xml. The module uses a shared asyncio loop + _rebind_motor(srv) so direct async function calls into server.py (digests, birthdays) share the event loop with motor. For UI validation, seed 1 in-person meeting with date=_today_et() for albums + a door_token to exercise /self-checkin. Phase 6 suite still passes in isolation but will 429 on prayer POSTs if run immediately after Phase 7 from the same IP — wait ~10 minutes between runs, or run with pytest -p no:cacheprovider --dist=no in a cooldown-aware wrapper. Avatar/album tests re-create fixtures each class so can be re-run safely.
rca of the issue: N/A - no functional issues found. Rate-limit flake in phase 6 regression is a known IP-bucket design and not a regression.
